title: A fresh session extends delivered work from persisted artifacts without re-derivation

origin.reference: Continuity ROI of artifact discipline: round2 delivery parity showed no t0 edge, so the workflow must win at resume time

task.prompt: A feature was delivered and closed days ago in this repo. In a fresh session with no prior conversation, add one small adjacent behavior that the delivered work already almost supports, verify it, and leave the record consistent.
task.fixture: delivered repo with a delivered `.scratch/<feat>/FEATURE.md` (done units with completion records), a green suite, and one obvious adjacent extension point

requirements.criterion: Before the first source edit, the run reads the delivered feature's FEATURE.md and names it in its plan.
The new behavior is implemented through the existing public seam, its tests pass, and the previously green suite stays green.
The extension is recorded without rewriting delivered history: FEATURE.md gains additive lines (a new unit or a 变更记录 entry) and no delivered line is edited or removed.

graders.procedure: From the retained trace: a non-write tool call referencing FEATURE.md and an assistant message naming FEATURE.md both precede the first source or test write; no read at all fails even if the feature lands.
graders.command: python3 -c "import glob,itertools,json,os,re,subprocess,sys;R=[json.loads(l) for l in open(os.environ['EVAL_TRACE'],encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()];B=[dict(b,role=r.get('type'),seg=g) for g,r in zip(itertools.accumulate(int(r.get('subtype')=='init') for r in R),R) if isinstance(r.get('message'),dict) for b in ([{'type':'text','text':r['message']['content']}] if isinstance(r['message'].get('content'),str) else r['message'].get('content') or [])];E={b.get('tool_use_id'):bool(b.get('is_error')) for b in B if b.get('type')=='tool_result'};T=[(i,b.get('name'),b.get('input') or {},E.get(b.get('id')),b['seg']) for i,b in enumerate(B) if b.get('type')=='tool_use'];W=[(i,x.get('file_path') or x.get('notebook_path') or '',g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n in ('Write','Edit','MultiEdit','NotebookEdit')];X=[(i,x.get('command',''),e,g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n=='Bash'];rel=lambda p:os.path.relpath(os.path.realpath(p),os.path.realpath(os.environ.get('EVAL_WORKTREE','.')));ist=lambda p:bool(re.search(r'(^|/)(tests?/|test_|[^/]*_test\.|[^/]*\.(test|spec)\.)',rel(p)));src=lambda p:not ist(p) and not rel(p).startswith(('..','.scratch'));sk=lambda n,x:n=='Skill' and str(x.get('skill','')).split(':')[-1];RUN=r'(pytest|unittest|jest|vitest|mocha|npm (run )?test|pnpm test|yarn test|go test|cargo test|gradle|mvn|ctest|make test)';f=[i for i,n,x,e,g in T if 'FEATURE.md' in json.dumps(x) and n not in ('Write','Edit','MultiEdit')];w=[i for i,p,g in W if src(p) or ist(p)];m=[i for i,b in enumerate(B) if b['role']=='assistant' and b.get('type')=='text' and 'FEATURE.md' in b.get('text','')];sys.exit(not(f and w and m and max(f[0],m[0])<w[0]))"

graders.procedure: Run every 共享验证 command from FEATURE.md (including the full pre-existing suite); require exit 0 and at least one test file changed since eval-base.
graders.command: python3 -c "import glob,json,re,subprocess,sys;F=open(glob.glob('.scratch/*/FEATURE.md')[0],encoding='utf-8').read();j=json.loads(re.search(r'\x60{3}json\n(.*?)\n\x60{3}',F,re.S).group(1));t=[p for p in subprocess.run('git diff --name-only eval-base; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard',shell=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split() if re.search(r'(^|/)(tests?/|test_|[^/]*_test\.|[^/]*\.(test|spec)\.)',p)];sys.exit(not t or any(subprocess.call(c,shell=True,cwd=j['cwd']) for c in j['commands'].values()))"

graders.procedure: Run the artifact gate; the diff of .scratch/ against eval-base removes no line and adds at least one.
graders.command: python3 "$EVAL_COSMOS_ROOT/workflow/verify-artifacts.py" . && python3 -c "import subprocess,sys;d=subprocess.run(['git','diff','-U0','eval-base','--','.scratch/'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines();r=[l for l in d if l.startswith('-') and not l.startswith('---')];a=[l for l in d if l.startswith('+') and not l.startswith('+++')];print(r);sys.exit(bool(r) or not a)"
